review:
A retro fruit cluster game made with Perfect Position – with a few cheeky aubergines thrown in. Electric Wins and random Rush multipliers up to 100x spice up the base game.

There are three buy options, including Hyper Spins where every cell starts at a 64x multiplier, plus a mode that boosts your bonus chance by over 300%. High volatility, 10,000x max and 96.15% RTP. Free spins about once every 226 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
